resources.string: Enter your document details
The chip in your document opens with three details printed on the document. Type them as they appear there.
Document number
Date of birth
Date of expiry
6 digits: year, month, day. For example, 12 August 1974 is 740812.
Continue
Use the card access number instead
Use the document details instead
Enter the document number using letters and digits only.
Enter the date of birth as 6 digits: year, month, day.
Enter the date of expiry as 6 digits: year, month, day.
Enter the 6 digits of the card access number.
The chip did not open with these details. Compare them with your document and try again.
Enter the card access number
Some cards have a 6-digit card access number (CAN) printed on the front. Type it as it appears.
Card access number
Hold your phone to the document
Passport: open it at the photo page and lay the back of your phone flat on that page.
Card: lay it on a table and place the top of the back of your phone on it.
Take the time you need. When the document and your phone are in place, press the button and keep both still.
I’m ready

The document moved away too often. Lay it and your phone on a table and try again.

Trouble reading the chip?
Take the document out of any cover or sleeve.
Take off your phone’s case if it is thick or has metal in it.
Move your phone slowly over the document. The reader is usually near the top or the middle of the back.
